learning_outcomes.text: Gains skills to make vectoral processing
solves problems related to one- and two- dimensional motions
defines motion of bodies in a system by the Newton's Motion Laws
describes work, work-energy, conservation of energy and so, defines translational motion of the bodies in the systems
describes linear momentum and conservation of the momentum and solves problems of collisions
calculates mass center and inertia moment
defines motion of the rotating bodies about a certain axis
determines circular motion of rigid object about fixed axis

syllabus_topics: Circular Motion and Other Application of Newton’s Laws
First midterm exam, Work and Energy
Potantial energy and conservation of energy
Potantial energy and conservation of energy (continued)
Second midterm exam, Linear momentum and collisions (continued)
Rotation of a Rigid Object About Fixed Axis
